CoreLib strings trailing zero trim fragment

policy.caller_required: Fresh module/full hash and CoreLib loaded-image origin; business image full hash/cache/origin and expected image/token identities; caller domain must equal fresh root global; authorized Reader; final Revalidate. View does not prove roster/binding/lifetime/atomicity.
policy.external_corelib_origin: Optional explicit VerifiedCorelibOrigin pointer and length tuple supplied only after caller worker dual full-buffer hashes and before/after callback origin validation; View skips whole raw buffer only, rereads exact source anchors and accessed metadata, and does not claim external hash/revalidation.

collection_rules.list: Only [0,_size), bounded by actual array length; private byte offsets resolved from closed class fields.
collection_rules.buckets: 0 empty; head=entryIndex+1; live next zero-based, -1 terminal; exact unchecked uint64 FastMod and multiplier pinned.
collection_rules.free_list: entry.next=-3-oldFreeList; decode -3-entry.next; -2 encodes end; all and only free rows reached once.
collection_rules.version: Remove does not increment _version; all observed links, live values, metadata and headers are reread.
collection_rules.comparer: Only null comparer for supported I4 value keys; custom comparer rejected without invocation.
collection_rules.empty: Never-allocated count=freeCount=0 and both arrays null allows freeList 0 or -1; declared Entry generic context and key/value/bucket types are validated before empty early return.
collection_rules.scope: ObjectRef.field_scope fixes declared field owner; no derived shadow-field fallback.
collection_rules.sparse: ListReferenceAt/ListInt32At validate headers and only requested slot; maximum capacity 65536; full enumeration max4096.
collection_rules.reference_types: CLASS type.data is cached klass (derived allowed); GENERICINST type.data->cached class must match exactly; SZARRAY type.data is element klass (native dispatch); inline GENERICINST rejected by Reference.
collection_rules.default_i4_hash: Int32 and strictly verified I4 enums only; alive hashCode must equal unchecked uint32(key); Enum.GetHashCode CorElementType 8 IL186 dispatch calls Int32.GetHashCode; custom comparer is rejected.
collection_rules.static_reference: Only ordinary reference TypeDef owners; exact declared static non-literal field; field type/payload width proved before read; fresh root domain global and class VTable backlink/cctor flags/slot count/static size/static base cell/value are observed and reread. Caller must match its domain to root; this build VTableDomain returns root.
collection_rules.headers: Object vtable word and second 8-byte header word both observed and reread; low vtable tag bits rejected without clearing. Array length is a 4-byte word at +24; adjacent +28 is not folded into length.
collection_rules.nullable: Closed Nullable value type has all required field ranges verified even when hasValue=false; stale value bytes are not read when absent.
collection_rules.revalidation: Every new high level or cached low level read invalidates completed observation flag; final reread compares all captured spans. Every attempted read and repeated reread consumes the same bounded 64MiB budget; no GC or atomicity authority is claimed.
collection_rules.external_origin: Origin must match current mono/image/raw/length and pinned exact string/table offsets and widths; source relocation, updates or observed metadata changes fail closed. Default in-view whole hash remains unchanged.
collection_rules.string_heap_extent: Saved #Strings stream length 531116 includes two final NUL bytes; this runtime trims extra trailing zero bytes retaining the last string terminator, so image+0x78 must equal exactly531115; raw/string origins unchanged; reads limited to effective runtime heap.
collection_rules.metadata_pages: Known effective #Strings heaps use <=4096-byte bounded pages; TypeDef/Field table pages use full rows <=4096 and clip at table end; all successful page reads are observed/revalidated. Unknown native strings remain bounded byte reads. Maximum counts/bytes unchanged.
